label: The Saltmarsh Lyceum
summary: A seaside college of weather magic, where first-years bind a storm spirit and sit exams in the middle of a gale.

world.era: The three hundredth year of the Lyceum
world.setting: The Saltmarsh Lyceum, a college of weather magic on a windswept tidal island
world.description: Students come from every coast to learn to call wind, rain and fog. Each first-year binds a small weather spirit as a familiar, the four houses compete for the Tide Cup, and the causeway to the mainland floods twice a day, which is excellent for keeping students in after curfew and terrible for keeping them out of trouble.
rules: Magic takes practice and goes wrong in funny or frightening ways
Familiars have opinions, moods and appetites
House points, exams and rivalries matter to everyone here
Teachers are strict but fair, and secrets travel fast

narration.tone: Whimsical and warm, with real stakes and late-night mischief
